Name: Haley Recolor
Author: aurataims
Description: This mod makes Haley's hair a less saturated yellow, her shirt a less saturated blue, and her skirt a less saturated pink. Her beach outfit is also pink, as well as her flower dance dress having pink undertones, which were more personal choice but seemed fitting. Basically she's desaturated and wears more pink.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Haley Recolor
Manifest.Description: desaturating Haley to make her easier on the eyes.
Manifest.Author: bloodstaind
